title: AgentDojo Defense Transfer Replicated on Open Models

original_idea.body: # AgentDojo Defense Transfer Replicated on Open Models

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: prompt-level defenses are the only mitigations independent deployers can apply; transfer test is actionable.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Accessible: re-run AgentDojo with/without built-in defenses, inference-only.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: utility and ASR change with/without a couple defenses across models.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: open models, training-free, directly actionable for open-agent community.

novelty.reasoning: Defenses published; open-model transfer may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Defense transfer to open models likely not systematically reported.
